note: This tree is the source for the public host cluster. Do not attach a Worker to spwashi.com. Do not mention infrastructure ownership in public HTML.

serving.note: How each host answers (2026-11-11). A fixed answer is a file, served at the edge without running code; the worker runs for what computes. files: the assets layer answers everything and the worker runs only for its declared exceptions (or never). mixed: the worker runs first, with declared file exceptions. script: the worker answers everything. check:workers holds each unit's wrangler config to its tier. A held name never redirects to spwashi.com, since public HTML must not show ownership; its next step is a file-only worker of its own. www to each apex belongs to a Redirect Rule in the dashboard.

spw-quest.next: the guide rooms that answer one page without a query; the card and query space stay scripted; / is a file since 2026-11-16 (carry-guide.mjs)

smut-today.next: files, with the day picked in the reader's page from a schedule file and the cookie's choices kept in the page

autonomous-feedback.next: privacy, robots and the kind files as files; measure the five-minute cron and peer fetches before cutting them

mutex-buzz.next: mutex.buzz answers here once its route moves in the dashboard (2026-11-16: under site-hub-next it answered 429, error 1027); until then site-hub-next still answers it from src/mutex.js, which can go after the move. Which hold is open is worked out in the reader's browser; /now.json is the schedule through 2027, and carry.mjs extends it

attention-productions.next: attention.productions answers here since 2026-11-16 through the Worker route attention.productions/* (fail closed). Cloudflare refused it as a custom domain because the apex is a proxied CNAME to site-hub-bih.pages.dev (externally managed DNS); with no route on it the apex shows error 1014, so the route stays until that record is deleted and the custom domain added. www.attention.productions/* is still a site-hub-next route, which answers 429 (1027) while the daily Worker requests are spent; a Redirect Rule from www to the apex would answer it before any Worker. site-hub-next src/hosts/attention.js can go once www no longer reaches it

texture-website.next: texture.website answers here since 2026-11-11 (its route moved in the dashboard); www.texture.website/* can leave site-hub-next, since a Redirect Rule answers it first

site-hub-next.next: split by host since 2026-11-11 (src/hosts/), texture.website gone to its own unit; each held name and attention.productions become file-only units carried from renderDoor and their pages; mutex.buzz from a schedule; tealstripesvibes.com stays scripted
